body: An online school survey receives responses mainly from students with reliable home internet; many students with poor connectivity do not respond.

The results may underrepresent access difficulties and should not be presented as the experience of every student in the school. The method of response favours students who already have access, creating a connection between participation and the issue being measured.

A survey summary should identify who responded and avoid extending findings to populations that were not adequately represented. A large response count cannot automatically remove selection bias when the missing group differs in a relevant way.
Report the recruitment method and response pattern, then offer an accessible alternative way for underrepresented students to participate.

body: Ketua projek tersalah memasukkan tarikh tempahan sehingga bilik tidak tersedia; dia boleh menyalahkan ahli lain atau menerangkan kesilapan dan mencari ruang gantian.

Mengakui kesilapan serta mengatur ruang gantian lebih membantu kumpulan daripada menyembunyikan punca sebenar masalah. Pembetulan segera menangani kesan kepada peserta, sementara pengakuan membolehkan kelemahan proses tempahan diperbaiki.

Bertanggungjawab selepas kesilapan melibatkan pengakuan, pembetulan kesan dan perubahan proses untuk mengurangkan kejadian berulang. Mengaku tidak bermaksud menghukum diri tanpa batas; tindakan seterusnya perlu tertumpu pada pemulihan dan pembelajaran.
Maklumkan pihak terjejas, laksanakan penyelesaian dan tambah semakan tarikh bersama sebelum tempahan akan datang.
